en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, multi‑storey early 20th‑century building on a street corner. The house has steep, tiled roofs, dormer windows, and smooth plaster façades with many tall rectangular and some oval windows. A decorative entrance with a curved pediment faces the street. Below one window is a signboard above a doorway, and a small two‑wheeled cart stands nearby. The overall scene is urban and appears to depict a public or commercial building.
